Hi. Sorry. My fault. Yes - I tried to create a new SQL integration with a DB -URL similar to the example Adobe (connecting to MS SQL)

I just tested this and it works fine.
I just erase the content of that field and leave it blank and it will pick it up again.

Possibly you are not using the default HA db (sqlite) but something else instead?
That won't work as currently it can only pickup the sqlite db which is the default db out of box. For other db's/settings you need to manually specify the path.

I use the original database, in the original location, on HomeAssistant OS.
[sqlite web](https://github.com/hassio-addons/addon-sqlite-web) accesses it without any problem also without indicating where DB is located

if there is something that can help to find the source of the problem (additional logs? changes in files?), write me what to do.
